notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/790333ded9d21fb050514d8d603107c5284a16b8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new 50th title called My Grandpa's Haunted House which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Survival horror games then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870070/My_Grandpas_Haunted_House/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Indie Horror Games Bundle #2[/b] for celebrating the release of my 50th project called My Grandpa's Haunted House game on Steam and if you would like to purchase multiple horror games at a huge discount then this is your chance.

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #1 - Generic Controller Support Added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have been getting some feedback from the Steam community for supporting different types of controllers. So, from now on, PS3 and other generic controllers will work with the game. It only had XBOX 360 Controller support in the beginning. This will be helpful for the players who wants to play with different generic controllers.

In this update, I have added generic controller support for all of you. However, I was getting some requests to add XBOX One controller support.

[b]Changes to controls:[/b]
1. Instead of using "Y" and "A" to move the menu cursor up and down, you can now use "D-Pads" to control the menu cursors.
2. Volume settings can be changed using D-Pads too.

I regret to inform you that, at this point in time, XBOX One controller is not fully compatible with the game. However, it should work with XBOX 360 and other generic controllers without any issue. I, myself, have tested with 2 different controllers including, wired Microsoft XBOX 360 and with generic PS3 controller.

I am looking into some other ways to make XBOX One controller work with the game and it might take some time. 

Meanwhile, you can use Xpadder to map the keyboard keys and mouse to your XBOX One controller controls and it will work flawlessly. I am sorry for the inconvenience and I am looking into other ways to make the XBOX One controller work. Thanks to your patience!

Please let me know if you have any further suggestions or feedback to improve the game.

Best Regards,
Anamik
